questions.question: Who was the founder of the Gupta Dynasty?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sri Gupta founded the Gupta Empire around 240-280 AD. He was succeeded by his son Ghatotkacha before the empire rose to prominence under Chandragupta I

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
श्री गुप्त ने लगभग 240-280 ईस्वी में गुप्त साम्राज्य की स्थापना की थी। उनके बाद उनके पुत्र घटोत्कच उत्तराधिकारी बने, जिसके बाद चंद्रगुप्त प्रथम के नेतृत्व में साम्राज्य का विस्तार हुआ।

questions.question: What is ‘Udranga’ under the Gupta administration?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
It is generally understood as a land-related or agricultural tax, mentioned in Gupta inscriptions. The Guptas had a well-organized revenue system with various taxes such as Bhaga, Bhoga, Kara, and Udranga

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इसे सामान्यतः भूमि या कृषि संबंधी कर के रूप में समझा जाता है, जिसका उल्लेख गुप्त शिलालेखों में मिलता है। गुप्तों के पास भागा, भोग, करा और उद्रंगा जैसे विभिन्न करों के साथ एक सुव्यवस्थित राजस्व प्रणाली थी।

questions.question: Who wrote the book 'Pancha Siddhantika' during the Gupta period?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Pancha Siddhantika is a famous astronomical treatise written by Varahamihira, one of the greatest scholars of the Gupta period. The work compiles and analyzes five astronomical schools (Siddhantas), reflecting advanced scientific knowledge in ancient India

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पंच सिद्धांतिका गुप्त काल के महानतम विद्वानों में से एक वराहमिहिर द्वारा रचित एक प्रसिद्ध खगोलीय ग्रंथ है। यह कृति पाँच खगोलीय संप्रदायों (सिद्धांतों) का संकलन और विश्लेषण करती है, जो प्राचीन भारत में उन्नत वैज्ञानिक ज्ञान को दर्शाती है।

questions.question: Which military division had become rare in warfare during the Gupta period despite being part of the army in texts?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Classical Indian texts continued to mention the fourfold army (Chaturanga):
5. Infantry (Padati)
6. Cavalry (Ashva)
7. Elephants (Gaja)
8. Chariots (Ratha)

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शास्त्रीय भारतीय ग्रंथों में चतुरंग सेना का उल्लेख लगातार मिलता रहा है:
9. पैदल सेना (पदाति)
10. घुड़सवार सेना (अश्व)
11. हाथी (गज)
12. रथ

questions.question: Which Chinese traveler visited India during the reign of Chandragupta II?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Fa-Hien was the first Chinese traveler to visit India (399-414 AD) specifically to collect Buddhist texts during the reign of Chandragupta Vikramaditya

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
फाह्यान चंद्रगुप्त विक्रमादित्य के शासनकाल के दौरान बौद्ध ग्रंथों को एकत्र करने के लिए भारत (399-414 ईस्वी) आने वाला पहला चीनी यात्री था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about succession in the Gupta dynasty is true?

options.a: Only the eldest son could become king
options.b: The eldest son was always crowned Yuvraj at priority
options.c: The ruler always declared himself divine to get the throne
options.d: Sons had to prove their eligibility before an assembly

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Gupta system of succession was not strictly based on primogeniture (eldest-son rule). Inscriptions and historical evidence suggest that royal sons had to establish their capability and acceptance, often before an assembly of nobles and ministers

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुप्त काल में उत्तराधिकार प्रणाली पूर्णतया ज्येष्ठाधिकार (बड़े पुत्र का शासन) पर आधारित नहीं थी। शिलालेखों और ऐतिहासिक साक्ष्यों से पता चलता है कि शाही पुत्रों को अक्सर सामंतों और मंत्रियों की सभा के समक्ष अपनी योग्यता और स्वीकार्यता साबित करनी पड़ती थी।

questions.question: Which Gupta king is credited with defeating the Hunas (Huns)?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Skandagupta successfully resisted the invasion of the Hunas, a fierce tribe from Central Asia. This feat is mentioned in the Bhitari Pillar Inscription

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्कंदगुप्त ने मध्य एशिया की एक क्रूर जनजाति हूणों के आक्रमण का सफलतापूर्वक प्रतिरोध किया था। इस उपलब्धि का उल्लेख भीतरी स्तंभ शिलालेख में मिलता है।

questions.question: The Iron Pillar located at Mehrauli, Delhi is associated with which ruler?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Mehrauli Iron Pillar inscription mentions a king named 'Chandra', generally identified as Chandragupta II. It is famous for its rust-resistant composition

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
महरौली लौह स्तंभ शिलालेख में 'चंद्र' नामक राजा का उल्लेख है, जिसकी पहचान आमतौर पर चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय के रूप में की जाती है। यह अपने जंग-रोधी गुणों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

questions.question: Who among the following was a famous physician during the Gupta period?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dhanvantri was one of the 'Navratnas' in the court of Chandragupta II and was a renowned expert in Ayurveda and medicine

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
धन्वंतरि चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय के दरबार के 'नवरत्नों' में से एक थे और आयुर्वेद एवं चिकित्सा के प्रसिद्ध विशेषज्ञ थे।

questions.question: The first inscriptional evidence of the practice of 'Sati' is found in:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dating back to 510 AD during the reign of Bhanugupta, the Eran inscription in Madhya Pradesh provides the first historical evidence of Sati

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भानुगुप्त के शासनकाल के दौरान 510 ईस्वी का मध्य प्रदेश में एरण शिलालेख सती प्रथा का पहला ऐतिहासिक साक्ष्य प्रदान करता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Gupta administration:
 1. The administration was highly centralized unlike the Mauryan empire.
 2. 'Bhuktis' were provinces headed by an officer called 'Uparika'.
 Select the correct statement(s):
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gupta administration was actually decentralized compared to the Mauryas. The empire was divided into Bhuktis (provinces) governed by Uparikas, which were further divided into Vishayas

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौर्यों की तुलना में गुप्त प्रशासन वास्तव में विकेंद्रीकृत था। साम्राज्य को उपरिकों द्वारा शासित भुक्तियों (प्रांतों) में विभाजित किया गया था, जिन्हें आगे विषयों में विभाजित किया गया था।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The Gupta period is known as the 'Golden Age' of Indian history.
 Reason (R): There was immense development in the fields of art, literature, science, and technology during this era.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The era saw geniuses like Kalidasa and Aryabhata, the construction of temples like Deogarh, and political stability, justifying the title 'Golden Age'

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इस युग में कालिदास और आर्यभट्ट जैसे विद्वान हुए, देवगढ़ जैसे मंदिरों का निर्माण हुआ और राजनीतिक स्थिरता रही, जो 'स्वर्ण युग' के नाम को सही ठहराती है।

questions.question:
Match the following Gupta taxes with their descriptions:
 1. Bhaga - i. Tax on water
 2. Vishti - ii. 1/6th of produce paid by cultivators
 3. Udakabhaga - iii. Forced labour
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Bhaga was the main land tax (1/6th), Vishti was forced labor for the state, and Udakabhaga was a specific tax levied on water usage

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भाग मुख्य भूमि कर (1/6) था, विष्टि राज्य के लिए किया गया जबरन श्रम था, और उदकभाग जल उपयोग पर लगाया जाने वाला विशिष्ट कर था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Vakataka Dynasty is INCORRECT?

options.a: They were contemporaries of the Guptas.
options.b: Vindhyashakti was the founder of this dynasty.
options.c: They completely opposed Buddhism and only followed Brahmanism.
options.d: Chandragupta II married his daughter Prabhavati Gupta into the Vakataka family.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Although they followed Brahmanism, they also patronized Buddhism. For instance, caves at Ajanta were built under the patronage of Vakataka king Harishena

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हालाँकि वे ब्राह्मणवाद के अनुयायी थे, लेकिन उन्होंने बौद्ध धर्म को भी संरक्षण दिया। उदाहरण के लिए, अजंता की गुफाएँ वाकाटक राजा हरिषेण के संरक्षण में बनाई गई थीं।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): Samudragupta is depicted playing the Veena on some of his gold coins.
 Reason (R): He was a great patron of music and was given the title 'Kaviraja'.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Samudragupta's 'Lyrist' type coins show his love for music. His titles like Kaviraja (King of Poets) reflect his intellectual and artistic interests

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समुद्रगुप्त के 'वीणा वादक' प्रकार के सिक्के उनके संगीत प्रेम को दर्शाते हैं। उनकी 'कविराज' जैसी उपाधियाँ उनके बौद्धिक और कलात्मक हितों को प्रतिबिंबित करती हैं।

questions.question:

Prayag Prashasti (4th century) and Mudrarakshasa (5th century) belong to the Gupta era. Aihole Prashasti was composed in 634 CE (7th century). Fa Xian visited in the 5th century (not 6th), Harshacharita is from the 7th century, and Kavirajamarga is from the 9th century.

questions.question: Which among the following was NOT a member of the Adhishthana Adhikarana of Kotivarsha in the Gupta period?

The district administration (Adhishthana Adhikarana) usually included the Nagarasreshthi, Sarthavaha, Prathama-kulika, and Prathama-kayastha. Mahattara referred to village elders.

questions.question: Who among the following kings is described in an inscription as the Supreme Being, the cause of the prosperity of the good and the destruction of the bad?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Allahabad Pillar Inscription (Prayag Prashasti) describes Samudragupta in divine terms, comparing him to gods and as a protector of the righteous.

questions.question: Which one of the following was composed by Harishena?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Harishena was the court poet of Samudragupta who composed the famous Prayaga Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription) in Sanskrit.

Kumargupta I founded Nalanda in the 5th century, and later Gupta kings like Narasimhagupta Baladitya were known patrons of Buddhism.
